name: @payswap/route-compiler
description: Route optimization contracts and deterministic compiler (Work Order P5-W1): best execution, route scoring and mixed-rail compilation. ONE Money Movement Intent compiles into multi-leg RoutePlans through a deterministic pure function (no ambient clock, no randomness, no network) — the provider-native path is the BASELINE candidate (INV-C08: emitted, never ranked away), and composed/multi-provider routes enter comparison ONLY through the five-requirement comparability gate (current eligibility, credible pricing, actual connection/permission, funding/payout constraints, auditable assumptions per leg). Route, quote, authority and evidence lineage is preserved as exact observation VERSIONS (the graph keeps the versions it decided on); liquidity estimates are ADVISORY ONLY — never custody, never authorization; the scoring engine evaluates declared dimensions through exact rational arithmetic and never consults execution mode or origin (baseline indifference). Zero runtime dependencies; devDependencies are exactly the toolchain (typescript + vitest); every cross-lane contract shape is a LOCAL STRUCTURAL PIN (the v1 intelligence-layer leaf-in-flight law — the TL wires the types at integration).
